mentions.name: Lifosy
mentions.description: A personal life-organization tool that centralizes notes, a habit tracker, brag doc, action log, todos, events, data collection, and unlimited biolinks in one place. It is a mix of PWA and local-first with GitHub sync, works seamlessly on smartphone and browser, stores everything as files the user can access and clone locally, and includes Typeform-like forms.
mentions.problem: Existing tools like Obsidian were always missing something or had configuration that was too complex, so the author started building their own instead of using separate habit tracker, notes, and brag doc services.
mentions.audience: A personal tool for the author's own life organization, explicitly built for individual daily use on both browser and smartphone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tool to organize my life.

All the things that are important to me in one place: notes, habit tracker, brag doc, action log, todos, events, data collection, biolinks, and a lot more.
